data.one_liner: Provides mock device frames to preview Flutter UI on various device screens.
data.what_it_does: The package renders a visual frame that mimics real phones, tablets, and desktops around any widget. It also offers a virtual keyboard and media‑query/theme inheritance to simulate device conditions.
use_when: Testing UI on multiple device sizes without real hardware
Demonstrating app screenshots for marketing or documentation
Developing responsive layouts with accurate safe‑area insets
avoid_when: Running in production builds where the frame adds unnecessary UI overhead
strengths: Simple API – just wrap your widget in DeviceFrame
Supports virtual keyboard and custom generic devices
weaknesses: Only for preview – not meant for release builds
Adds extra widget layer which may affect performance in debug
